No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this walk you read an ambitious unfinished temple through plans and stone-working evidence.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Site context and plan
  • Monument superstructure and surviving stone
  • Tool marks and architectural reconstruction
  • Landscape and construction hypotheses

How the time is spent

  1. Site context and plan 25 min

  2. Monument superstructure and surviving stone 35 min

  3. Tool marks and architectural reconstruction 50 min

  4. Landscape and construction hypotheses 30 min

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Read the site plan of the Bhojeshwar Temple and place the monument in its setting.
  • Identify tool marks and surviving stone that show how the temple was being built.
  • Compare construction hypotheses for the unfinished temple and the landscape evidence behind them.

You take away

An interpretation sheet with questions to ask on site and suggested reading.
